description: Two PlayerProfile/result-flow improvements that are independent of the FEAT-001 refactor. (Task 3) Fix mission day-rollover across midnight: today missions are computed live from DateTime.now() but mission progress/_missionDay only reset in load(); if the app stays open past midnight, progress belongs to yesterday. (Task 4) Surface a small, friendly pet round-moment on all six result screens showing the round's pet XP gain and a 'Buddy grew!' banner on level-up/stage-change (addPetXp currently feeds the pet silently). Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-003.
steps: Task 3 — in lib/core/services/player_profile.dart add a private Future<void> _rolloverMissionsIfNeeded(): final today=_todayKey(); if(_missionDay!=today){ _missionDay=today; _missionProgress.clear(); _missionClaimed.clear(); await _prefs?.setString(_kMissionDay, today); await _prefs?.remove(_kMissionProgress); await _prefs?.remove(_kMissionClaimed); } This mirrors load()'s else-branch exactly.

Task 3 — call await _rolloverMissionsIfNeeded() at the START of reportMission(MissionMetric, int) and claimMission(MissionDef) BEFORE their existing logic (before the amount<=0 guard is fine, but place it first so a past-midnight report rolls over before applying). Keep todaysMissions using DateTime.now() and Missions.forDay unchanged. Do not alter the deterministic rotation. Keep load()'s existing reset path as-is (it is consistent with the helper).

Task 3 — add test/mission_rollover_test.dart: SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues with a stale day, e.g. compute yesterday's day-key string in the same format PlayerProfile uses (YYYY-MM-DD) and seed {'profile_mission_day': <yesterday>, 'profile_mission_progress': ['<someId>:5'], 'profile_mission_claimed': ['<someId>']}. Load the profile, then call reportMission(MissionMetric.correctAnswers, 1) and assert that stale progress for yesterday's ids is gone (missionProgress for a stale id is 0), _missionDay persisted equals today (read 'profile_mission_day' back), and only today's matching missions advanced. Also assert Missions.forDay(fixed DateTime) returns a stable 3-mission list across two calls.

Task 4 — in lib/core/services/player_profile.dart expose the round's pet change. Add transient (non-persisted) fields int _lastRoundPetXp=0; bool _lastRoundPetLeveledUp=false; int _lastRoundPetNewLevel=0; bool _lastRoundPetStageChanged=false; with public getters lastRoundPetXp, lastRoundPetLeveledUp, lastRoundPetNewLevel, lastRoundPetStageChanged. In onRoundFinished, BEFORE calling addPetXp, capture beforeLevel=petLevel and beforeStage=Pet.stageForLevel(beforeLevel); after addPetXp(coinsEarned) set _lastRoundPetXp=coinsEarned (the delta actually fed), afterLevel=petLevel, _lastRoundPetNewLevel=afterLevel, _lastRoundPetLeveledUp=afterLevel>beforeLevel, _lastRoundPetStageChanged = Pet.stageForLevel(afterLevel).name != beforeStage.name. Reset the four fields to defaults at the very start of onRoundFinished so a round with 0 coins shows nothing. Do NOT change addPetXp's persistence or pet-achievement logic. Import for Pet is already present.

Task 4 — create lib/core/widgets/pet_round_moment.dart: a StatelessWidget PetRoundMoment({required PlayerProfile profile}). If profile.lastRoundPetXp<=0 return const SizedBox.shrink(). Otherwise render a compact comic panel (reuse ComicPanel from core/widgets, AppTheme colors, const where possible) with the pet emoji (profile.petStage.emoji) and a '+<xp> Buddy XP' row; if profile.lastRoundPetStageChanged or profile.lastRoundPetLeveledUp, add a small friendly 'Buddy grew!' banner (comic style, non-scary, kid-friendly for ages 6-9). Keep it small and quick. Follow coding-conventions: const constructors, no MediaQuery.size.

Task 4 — insert PetRoundMoment(profile: widget.profile) into all SIX result screens, placed right AFTER the main reward ComicPanel and BEFORE the DoubleAwardsButton (keep edit shape identical across files): lib/games/number_quest/screens/result_screen.dart, lib/games/shape_safari/screens/safari_result_screen.dart, lib/games/word_wizard/screens/wizard_result_screen.dart, lib/games/clock_hero/screens/clock_result_screen.dart, lib/games/money_math/screens/money_result_screen.dart, lib/games/memory_match/screens/memory_result_screen.dart. Add the import '../../../core/widgets/pet_round_moment.dart' to each. For NQ's result_screen.dart, if a stage change happened you may let the existing Confetti still trigger via its _celebrate getter (do not change the celebrate logic beyond what's needed).

Run build web and flutter test; fix any compile errors. Record in findings the final PlayerProfile getter names exposed and confirmation that result screens render the moment only when lastRoundPetXp>0.
acceptance_criteria: reportMission and claimMission roll the mission day over (reset progress + claimed, update and persist _missionDay) before applying when the stored day is not today; Missions.forDay rotation is unchanged.

PlayerProfile exposes lastRoundPetXp/lastRoundPetLeveledUp/lastRoundPetNewLevel/lastRoundPetStageChanged, reset each round and set around addPetXp in onRoundFinished; pet XP amount fed is unchanged (equals coinsEarned).
All six result screens render a small friendly PetRoundMoment after the reward panel, showing nothing when the round's pet XP delta is 0; non-scary styling.
findings: DONE. Task 3: added private PlayerProfile._rolloverMissionsIfNeeded() mirroring load()'s else-branch (resets _missionProgress/_missionClaimed, sets+persists _missionDay, removes the two mission pref lists). Called it at the START of reportMission() and claimMission() before their existing logic. Missions.forDay rotation and load()'s reset path left unchanged. Task 4: PlayerProfile now exposes four transient (non-persisted) getters: lastRoundPetXp (int, == coinsEarned fed), lastRoundPetLeveledUp (bool), lastRoundPetNewLevel (int), lastRoundPetStageChanged (bool). All four are reset to defaults at the very start of onRoundFinished and set around addPetXp (beforeLevel/beforeStage captured before, afterLevel after). addPetXp persistence and pet-achievement logic untouched; XP fed is still coinsEarned. New widget lib/core/widgets/pet_round_moment.dart: StatelessWidget PetRoundMoment({required PlayerProfile profile}); returns const SizedBox.shrink() when lastRoundPetXp<=0, otherwise a ComicPanel with petStage.emoji + '+<xp> XP' and a friendly '🎉 Buddy grew!' banner (AppTheme.success) when lastRoundPetLeveledUp or lastRoundPetStageChanged. Inserted PetRoundMoment(profile: widget.profile) in all SIX result screens right before 'const DoubleAwardsButton()' (NQ, shape_safari, word_wizard, clock_hero, money_math, memory_match), each with the import '../../../core/widgets/pet_round_moment.dart'. NQ's Confetti _celebrate logic left unchanged. Result screens render the moment ONLY when lastRoundPetXp>0 (0-coin round shows nothing). Added test/mission_rollover_test.dart (2 tests): seeds a stale yesterday mission day and asserts reportMission clears stale progress/claimed, persists today's day-key, advances only today's matching missions by 1; plus asserts Missions.forDay(fixed) is a stable 3-mission list. Verification: build web -> 'Built build\web' present; flutter test -> all 14 pass. flutter analyze NOT run (crashes on Hebrew path).
